objective: Agent turns an architecture diagnosis into an ordered, simulated refactoring plan: Phase 1 report with impact tiers, Phase 2 one candidate per critical/active finding expanded from the family's repair `## Ops recipe` (new names via get_naming_lexicon, new edges between existing files judged with plannedEdges, MISFIT edge never proposed, rationale = finding key), Phase 3 restructurePlan ordering (report split/merge candidates included unless the estimated cost exceeds one call's budget on a large repo — bd tea-rags-mcp-vytjl), Phase 4 refactoring-scan annotation that never reorders, Phase 5 hand-off to dinopowers:writing-plans with one Task per step carrying the expected delta and the DDG Step 7 gate line, trade-offs and unselected listed apart, never as Tasks, plus the execution contract (compare review_changes delta per Task, Step 7 repair, re-plan the remaining candidates on the real tree when repair does not converge). Eval prompts use neutral user framing.

runs.scope: 8 cases: candidates (2), order (2), annotate (1), plan (2), execution-contract (1); bd tea-rags-mcp-cm9gt.4
runs.method: Blind two-arm run. Subjects: sonnet subagents, one per arm, answering every scenario from context + prompt only (reads only, no MCP calls). Arm withoutRule read the get_architecture_report schema + description, the four repair Ops recipes, architecture-diagnostics Phase 3i and DDG Step 6b/7 (no skill existed). Arm withRule read the same plus the new SKILL.md. Neither saw expected. Strict grading by the orchestrator: every mustDo met and no mustNotDo hit.

failureMap.recipe-sdp-inversion: baseline expanded the recipe correctly but never checked the new interface name with get_naming_lexicon
failureMap.tradeoffs-not-tasks: baseline kept trade-off/unselected out of Tasks but never handed off to dinopowers:writing-plans
failureMap.divergence-replans: baseline escalated to the user (DDG two-round stop) and only proposed the re-plan, folding the diverged candidate back in
failureMap.large-repo-report-candidates-off: baseline sent all 22 caller candidates in one call and cited no reason/bead for includeReportCandidates false
failureMap.task-carries-expected-delta-and-gate: baseline wrote a per-Task 'stop and replan' line but no execution contract naming restructurePlan over the remaining candidates and the Task update

runs.note: misfit-edge-dropped, scan-annotation-no-reorder and report-candidates-included pass both arms: the tool description and recipes already carry MISFIT, the never-select-trade-off rule and the cheap-estimate reasoning; they pin the skill against regression.
